name: Philippines

fees.name: 9(a) Temporary Visitor's Visa - single entry (consular)
fees.validity: 3 months validity, stay up to 59 days
fees.applies: visa-free (E.O. 408) nationals applying at a Philippine embassy/consulate
fees.notes: USD 40 for non-visa-free nationals; USD 25 for Chinese nationals (see reciprocity_variations). Fees are set in USD by DFA but posts publish local-currency equivalents (e.g. Oslo NOK 360 single / NOK 720 multiple; China CNY 190/228/304 single entry).

fees.name: 9(a) Temporary Visitor's Visa - multiple entry (consular)
fees.applies: all visa-required applicants; availability varies by nationality
fees.notes: No single USD schedule published; local-currency examples (China): 6-month CNY 456 (E.O. 408 nationals) / CNY 608 (others) / CNY 760 (Chinese); 12-month CNY 684 / CNY 912. Norway: NOK 720 multiple 6-month.

fees.name: Philippine e-Visa (9(a) Temporary Visitor, evisa.gov.ph)
fees.validity: single entry (7-12 working days processing) or multiple entry (15-21 working days)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (rollout includes China, India, Taiwan and others)
fees.notes: Fee is displayed dynamically per nationality during application on evisa.gov.ph and is not published as a static schedule; could not verify a universal amount on an official source. Reports indicate USD 25 for Chinese nationals, consistent with the consular reciprocity rate.

fees.name: 9(a) Temporary Visitor's Visa - business
fees.validity: 3 months validity, stay up to 59 days
fees.applies: visa-free nationals (same 9(a) category and fee as tourism)
fees.notes: The Philippines uses the same 9(a) visa for pleasure and business; same fee schedule (USD 30/40/25).

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: The Philippines has no separate transit visa category; transiting passengers who leave the airport need a 9(a) visa if visa-required. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime exists; visa-required nationals must obtain a visa (consular or e-visa) before travel.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced 9(a) single-entry fee for Chinese nationals (USD 25 vs USD 30/40); in China: CNY 190 single, CNY 380 3-month multiple, CNY 760 6-month multiple. Since June 2025 Chinese (and Indian) nationals also get 14-day visa-free entry for tourism/business.
Non-visa-free (non-E.O. 408) nationals pay USD 40 single entry. India additionally received 14-day visa-free entry (non-extendible) from 8 June 2025 and is e-visa eligible.
E.O. 408 visa-free nationals: 30 days visa-free on arrival at no cost; USD 30 if a 9(a) visa for longer stay is applied for at a consulate.

vfs.note: VFS Global runs Philippine visa application centres in China (service fee CNY 138 per application) and Philippine e-visa/consular service centres in several other countries (e.g. Hong Kong); many VFS 'Philippines' centres elsewhere handle passport renewal only. Service fees vary by centre.

free_visa_notes: Nationals of 157 countries (E.O. 408 list, incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS and most of Europe/ASEAN) enter visa-free for 30 days with no fee. China and India nationals get 14-day visa-free entry (from 2025). Visa fees above apply only to visa-required nationals or those needing longer stays.
